svg.text: BB Learn: the owl, on the PixelBoard
a spotted owlet (Athene brama), drawn in the same cells as the site's 5×7 BRAINBACK · rough sketch for planning
The lockup: the owl lives on the board
one feather out of place: the imperfection that makes it feel alive
half the face, big pupils, a dark rim: baby schema, reads as young and safe
the owlet's real white brows, set high and open: friendly, not stern
two pale cells on the midline, the logo's split between the two halves
the white spots of India's commonest owl, lit like the board's sparkles
two cells, planted: it stays put, it's a companion, not a performer
for teens, and the UI corner
big eyes, pupils centred and soft
pupils up, toward the child who is
crescent eyes, for effort, not for
half-lidded: it's late, go to bed
